description: This file contains unit tests for the MenuSessionsInjector class, specifically testing its ability to manipulate NSMenu items related to session management, control channels, and usage summaries within a macOS application.

classes.name: MenuSessionsInjectorTests
classes.description: A test suite structured for testing the MenuSessionsInjector integration with NSMenu, verifying the addition and ordering of menu items, as well as injection of session session data and usage summaries.

methods.name: anchorsDynamicRowsBelowControlsAndActions
methods.description: Tests that the injector correctly finds the insertion index for session-related menu items below control actions.

methods.name: injectsDisconnectedMessage
methods.description: Verifies that the injector properly updates the menu to reflect a disconnected control channel state.

methods.name: injectsSessionRows
methods.description: Tests injection of session rows into the menu, verifying menu item order and presence of injected items based on session data.

methods.name: cost usage submenu does not use injector delegate
methods.description: Ensures that the cost usage submenu is generated without delegate interference, verifying its existence and delegation setting.
